answer: Locks are recorded in timber, expire in umber, and quartz lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 10 aliases hence needs 200 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3919 identities would post 2530 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
